title: Add the RBAC (roles & permissions) module
description: Copy the RBAC module — permission/role models + services, the CURRENT_USER_PERMISSIONS token with its self-contained RbacDemoSessionService default, permissionGuard, the permissions/roles admin pages, and the forbidden page — into an existing project, and wire its routes as ordinary children of whatever main shell already exists (or as flat top-level routes if there is none). Deliberately minimal schema: RBAC has no auth-style runtime-strategy branch to parameterize. Fully decoupled from modules:auth in both directions — works standalone with zero auth setup, see CURRENT_USER_PERMISSIONS for the one-line override any real auth setup provides.

list.description: Print a one-line self-description and exit without writing anything.

routePrefix.description: Where the admin pages mount — '<routePrefix>/permissions' and '<routePrefix>/roles'. The one genuinely configurable thing about where this feature lives in an app's URL structure. The 'forbidden' page is always mounted at the fixed top-level '/forbidden', matching permissionGuard's redirect target.
